description: Lethenes wears a cream ankle-length tunic with narrow gold-brown patterned borders along the collar, front, cuffs and lower hem. A dark burgundy-purple long outer coat or mantle has richer matching woven borders and drapes over one shoulder, fastened by a small round red-centered gold-toned brooch. A broad decorated belt with round buckle and a long studded hanging end defines the waist. Brown trousers and tall closed brown boots show below the tunic. Garments appear finely woven and opaque, with linen-like inner cloth and wool-like outer cloth; exact fibers uncertain. No headgear, armor, weapon or crown appears.
